# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# load packages
library(easystats)
library(conflicted)
library(here)
library(brms)
library(bayestestR)
library(tidybayes)
library(bayesplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(DHARMa)
library(tictoc)
library(future)
library(future.apply)
library(mice)
library(marginaleffects)
library(priorsense)
library(posterior)
library(loo)
library(shinystan)
library(shinybrms)
library(ggdist)
library(brmsmargins)
library(viridis)
library(ggnewscale)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpmisc)
library(gginnards)
library(ggridges)
library(ggpubr)

# set package parameters
theme_set(theme_bw())

# CAUTION: calculations in this notebook assume 12 cores available from total of 16
# parallelised processing settings would need to be amended throughout the notebook if
# a different number of cores are available
n_cores <- max(1, parallelly::availableCores() - 4)
future::plan(future::multisession, workers = n_cores)

options(marginaleffects_parallel_inferences = TRUE)
options(marginaleffects_parallel = TRUE)
options(marginaleffects_parallel_packages = c("marginaleffects", "brms"))
options(marginaleffects_posterior_interval = "eti")
options(marginaleffects_posterior_center = stats::median)

bayesplot::bayesplot_theme_set(bayesplot::theme_default(base_family = "serif", base_size = 16))
bayesplot::bayesplot_theme_update(axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "serif", size = 14))

set.seed(808)

```

## rescaling variables

```{r}

# rescale variables

centre_vars = c("UASLAeqMaxLR", "UASLAEMaxLR", "UASEPNLMaxLR", "UASLAF50ExMaxLR",
                "Age", "NoiseSensitivity")

out <- standardise_list(list(subjData, subjDataNoAmb),
                        vars = centre_vars,
                        scale = FALSE)

subjData <- out[[1]]
subjDataNoAmb <- out[[2]]

centre_stim_vars = c("UASLAeqMaxLR", "UASLAEMaxLR", "UASEPNLMaxLR", "UASLAF50ExMaxLR")

out <- standardise_list(list(stimData, stimDataNoAmb),
                        vars = centre_stim_vars,
                        scale = FALSE)

stimData <- out[[1]]
stimDataNoAmb <- out[[2]]


out <- standardise_list(list(subjData, subjDataNoAmb),
                        vars = c("TrialNumber"),
                        scale = TRUE)

subjData <- out[[1]]
subjDataNoAmb <- out[[2]]

# rescale trial number variables
subjData <- rbind(subjData |>
                    dplyr::mutate(TrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(TrialNumber, scale=TRUE))) |>
  droplevels()

subjDataNoAmb <- rbind(subjDataNoAmb |>
                         dplyr::mutate(TrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(TrialNumber, scale=TRUE))) |>
  droplevels()


```

# dAnnoyance

## mdA1: maximal ordbeta model with random intercept only

### Model dA1 formula

```{R}

role_lookup <- c(
  UASProximity = "wsf", UASStart = "wsf", UASType = "wsf", UASOperation = "wsf",
  AmbientEnvCore = "wsf", AmbientVariant = "wsf",
  Ilog10UASEvents = "wsc", TrialNumberScl = "wsc", UASLAEMaxLRScl = "wsc",
  NationGeo2 = "bsf", AAM_attitude2 = "bsf", Home_Area2 = "bsf",
  Sex = "bsf", Area_soundscape2 = "bsf",
  AgeScl = "bsc", NoiseSensitivityScl = "bsc"
)

mdA1_pop_level <- c("TrialNumberScl", "AmbientEnvCore*UASStart",
                    "UASProximity*UASStart",
                    "AmbientEnvCore*UASProximity",
                    "AmbientEnvCore*I(log10(UASEvents))",
                    "AmbientEnvCore*UASOperation",
                    "AmbientEnvCore*UASType",
                    "AmbientVariant*UASType",
                    "UASType*I(log10(UASEvents))",
                    "UASOperation*UASType",
                    "NationGeo2", "AAM_attitude2", "Home_Area2",
                    "AgeScl", "Sex", "NoiseSensitivityScl", "Area_soundscape2")

mdA1_grp_level_id <- c()

mdA1_grp_level <- list(ID = mdA1_grp_level_id,
                     StimID = c())

mdA1formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                      fixed = mdA1_pop_level,
                      re = mdA1_grp_level)

mdA1Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, all.vars(mdA1formula$formula), drop=FALSE]

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

y_full <- mdA1Data$dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl
n0 <- sum(y_full == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n1 <- sum(y_full == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
N  <- sum(!is.na(y_full))

# Haldane-Anscombe Correction to avoid p0 or p1 being exactly 0 or 1, which would lead to infinite logit values
p0 <- (n0 + 0.5) / (N + 1)
p1 <- (n1 + 0.5) / (N + 1)

xi_center   <- qlogis(p0)              # solves plogis(xi) = p0 exactly
coi_center  <- qlogis(1 - p1)          # solves 1 - plogis(xi+kappa) = p1
kappa_center <- coi_center - xi_center  # must come out positive, given kappa's <lower=0> constraint

y_cont <- na.omit(mdA1Data)$dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl
y_cont <- y_cont[y_cont > 0 & y_cont < 1]
m <- mean(y_cont); v <- stats::var(y_cont)
phi_center <- log((m * (1 - m)) / v - 1)

tier_priors_dA1 <- c("2" = "normal(0, 0.3)", "3" = "normal(0, 0.1)")

main_effects <- list(
  list(vars = "UASLAEMaxLRScl",  prior = "normal(0.2, 0.5)"),
  list(vars = "Ilog10UASEvents", prior = "normal(0.5, 1)"),
  list(vars = "TrialNumberScl",  prior = "normal(0.1, 0.5)")
)

priorsdA1 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA1formula, mdA1Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA1_pop_level, tier_priors_dA1, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)

tic()
mdA1Priors <- brms::brm(mdA1formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA1PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA1Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA1PriorCheck

tic()
mdA1 <- brms::brm(mdA1formula, data=mdA1Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA1, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA1 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA1, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA1$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA1))
mdA1$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA1, re_formula=NA))
mdA1$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA1, re_formula=NULL))

```

## mdA2: reduced maximal ordinal model for dAnnoyance

### Model dA2 formula

```{R}

mdA2_pop_level <- prune_terms(mdA1_pop_level, c("AmbientEnvCore*UASStart"))

mdA2_grp_level <- mdA1_grp_level

mdA2formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                       fixed = mdA2_pop_level,
                       re = mdA2_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA2 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA2formula, mdA1Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA2_pop_level, tier_priors_dA1, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)

tic()
mdA2Priors <- brms::brm(mdA2formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA2, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA2PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA2Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA2PriorCheck

tic()
mdA2 <- brms::brm(mdA2formula, data=mdA1Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA2, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA2 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA2, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA2$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA2))
mdA2$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA2, re_formula=NA))
mdA2$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA2, re_formula=NULL))

```

## mdA5: further reduced maximal ordinal model for dAnnoyance

### Model dA5 formula

```{R}

mdA5_pop_level <- prune_terms(mdA4_pop_level, c("AmbientEnvCore*UASProximity"))
mdA5_pop_level <- unique(c(mdA5_pop_level, "UASProximity"))

mdA5_grp_level <- mdA4_grp_level

mdA5formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                       fixed = mdA5_pop_level,
                       re = mdA5_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA5 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA5formula, mdA1Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA5_pop_level, tier_priors_dA1, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)


tic()
mdA5Priors <- brms::brm(mdA5formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA5, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA5PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA5Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA5PriorCheck

tic()
mdA5 <- brms::brm(mdA5formula, data=mdA1Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA5, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA5 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA5, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA5$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA5))
mdA5$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA5, re_formula=NA))
mdA5$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA5, re_formula=NULL))

```

## mdA8: add group-level effects

### Model dA8 formula

```{R}

mdA8_pop_level <- prune_terms(mdA7_pop_level, c("UASLAEMaxLRScl"))  # keeping UASStart but omitting UASLAE

mdA8_grp_level_id <- c("TrialNumberScl",
                     "I(log10(UASEvents))",
                     "AmbientEnvCore",
                     "AmbientVariant",
                     "UASOperation",
                     "UASType",
                     "UASProximity",
                     "UASStart",
                     "AmbientEnvCore*UASOperation",
                     "AmbientEnvCore*UASType",
                     "AmbientEnvCore*I(log10(UASEvents))")

mdA8_grp_level <- list(ID = mdA8_grp_level_id,
                      StimID = c())

mdA8formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                       fixed = mdA8_pop_level,
                       re = mdA8_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA8 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA8formula, mdA1Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA8_pop_level, tier_priors_dA1, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)


tic()
mdA8Priors <- brms::brm(mdA8formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA8, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA8PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA8Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA8PriorCheck

tic()
mdA8 <- brms::brm(mdA8formula, data=mdA1Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA8, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA8 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA8, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA8$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA8))
mdA8$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA8, re_formula=NA))
mdA8$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA8, re_formula=NULL))

```

### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

mdA8_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(mdA8) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / stats::median(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(mdA8_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mdA8_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))

```

```{r}
# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights

    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
```

## mdA10: further reduced group-level effects model for dAnnoyance

### Model dA10 formula

```{R}

mdA10_pop_level <- mdA9_pop_level

mdA10_grp_level_id <- prune_terms(mdA9_grp_level_id, "AmbientEnvCore*I(log10(UASEvents))")
mdA10_grp_level_id <- unique(c(mdA10_grp_level_id, "AmbientEnvCore","I(log10(UASEvents))"))

mdA10_grp_level <- list(ID = mdA10_grp_level_id,
                      StimID = c())

mdA10formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                       fixed = mdA10_pop_level,
                       re = mdA10_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA10 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA10formula, mdA1Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA10_pop_level, tier_priors_dA1, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)


tic()
mdA10Priors <- brms::brm(mdA10formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA10, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA10PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA10Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA10PriorCheck

tic()
mdA10 <- brms::brm(mdA10formula, data=mdA1Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA10, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA10 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA10, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA10$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA10))
mdA10$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA10, re_formula=NA))
mdA10$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA10, re_formula=NULL))

```

```{R}
mdA12_pop_level <- mdA11_pop_level

mdA12_grp_level <- mdA11_grp_level

mdA12_dpar_pop_level <- c("UASType", "UASOperation", "UASProximity")

mdA12_dpar_grp_level <- mdA11_dpar_grp_level

mdA12formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                        fixed = mdA12_pop_level,
                        re = mdA12_grp_level,
                        dpars = list(phi = list(fixed = mdA12_dpar_pop_level,
                                                re = mdA12_dpar_grp_level)))

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA12 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA12formula, mdA1Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA12_pop_level, tier_priors_dA1, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  # brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "b", dpar = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)


tic()
mdA12Priors <- brms::brm(mdA12formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA12, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA12PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA12Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA12PriorCheck

tic()
mdA12 <- brms::brm(mdA12formula, data=mdA1Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA12, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA12 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA12, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA12$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA12))
mdA12$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA12, re_formula=NA))
mdA12$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA12, re_formula=NULL))

```

### plot calibration

```{r}

# create base datagrid
mdA13DataFit <- insight::get_data(mdA13)

set.seed(999)
mdA13predMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(mdA13, na.omit(mdA13DataFit),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                re_formula = NULL,
                                                transform=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

gc()

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mdA13predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=mdA13predMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(mdA13predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-10, 10, by=1), limits=c(-2, 8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-10, 10, by=1), limits=c(-2, 8)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_ExpMod_Cal_brmsOb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4.5, height=4.5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4.5, height=4.5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

mdA13_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(mdA13) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / stats::median(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(mdA13_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mdA13_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))

```

### set up marginal grids

```{r}

# ---- Setup ------------------------------------------------------------------

within_vars_all  <- c("AmbientEnvCore", "UASType", "UASOperation",
                       "AmbientVariant", "UASProximity", "UASEvents", "UASStart")
between_vars_all <- c("NationGeo2", "AAM_attitude2", "Home_Area2", "AgeScl",
                      "Sex", "NoiseSensitivityScl", "Area_soundscape2")

transform_dAnnoy <- \(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')
 
env_order <- c("Park", "Residential", "Streetside square", "Highway")
envvar_order <- c("Park", "Residential", "Park (high)", "Highway (low)", "Streetside square", "Highway")

# ---- full grids -------------------------------------------
 
# grid_marg: LAE varies naturally with each real design cell
grid_marg <- build_marginal_grid(
  mdA13, within_vars = within_vars_all, between_vars = between_vars_all,
  id_var = "ID", stim_var = "StimID", simulate_id = TRUE, simulate_stim = TRUE,
  n_new = nnew_pred, fixed_at_mean = "TrialNumberScl"
)

# ---- Restricted subsets, one per coverage rule above ------------------------
 
# Group 1 only: the single fully-crossed subset. Used for ANY analysis of
# AmbientEnvCore, UASOperation, or UASProximity.
grid_group1 <- subset(grid_marg, UASEvents == 1 & AmbientVariant == "Standard")

# Far + Overflight + Standard variant, spanning UASEvents 1/2/3: the only
# subset where event count varies while everything else stays within
# combinations that were actually tested.
grid_evts <- subset(grid_marg,
                      UASProximity == "Far" &
                        UASOperation == "Overflight" &
                        AmbientVariant == "Standard")

grid_park_variant <- subset(grid_marg, AmbientEnvCore == "Park" &
                              UASOperation == "Overflight" &
                              UASProximity == "Far" & UASEvents == 1)
grid_highway_variant <- subset(grid_marg, AmbientEnvCore == "Highway" &
                                 UASOperation == "Overflight" &
                                 UASProximity == "Far" & UASEvents == 1)

grid_resi_st_variant <- subset(grid_marg, !(AmbientEnvCore == "Highway" |
                                              AmbientEnvCore == "Park") &
                                 UASOperation == "Overflight" &
                                 UASProximity == "Far" & UASEvents == 1)

grid_envcomp_base <- subset(grid_marg,
                            UASOperation == "Overflight" &
                             UASProximity == "Far" &
                             UASEvents == 1)

```

```{r}
# predict for all environment core and variants but for the relevant restricted subset
make_state_grid <- function(base_grid, env, variant) {
  nd <- base_grid
  nd$AmbientEnvCore <- factor(env, levels = levels(base_grid$AmbientEnvCore))
  nd$AmbientVariant <- factor(variant, levels = levels(base_grid$AmbientVariant))
  nd
}

states <- list(
  "Park"           = c("Park", "Standard"),
  "Residential"    = c("Residential", "Standard"),
  "Park (high)"    = c("Park", "ParkHigh"),
  "Streetside square" = c("Streetside square", "Standard"),
  "Highway (low)"  = c("Highway", "HighwayLow"),
  "Highway"        = c("Highway", "Standard")
)

draws_list <- lapply(names(states), function(nm) {
  nd <- make_state_grid(grid_envcomp_base, states[[nm]][1], states[[nm]][2])
  set.seed(999)
  d <- brms::posterior_epred(mdA13, newdata = nd, re_formula = NULL,
                              allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
                              ndraws = ndraws_pred)
  rowMeans(transform_dAnnoy(d))
})
names(draws_list) <- names(states)

pairs_idx <- utils::combn(names(states), 2)
preserve_order <- list(c("Park (high)", "Park"), c("Highway (low)", "Highway"))

mdA13_envvar_contrasts_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(ncol(pairs_idx)), function(i) {
  hi <- pairs_idx[1, i]; lo <- pairs_idx[2, i]
  d <- draws_list[[hi]] - draws_list[[lo]]
  is_preserved <- any(sapply(preserve_order, function(p) setequal(p, c(hi, lo))))
  if (!is_preserved && mean(d) < 0) { d <- -d; tmp <- hi; hi <- lo; lo <- tmp }
  pd <- as.numeric(bayestestR::p_direction(d))
  data.frame(
    contrast = paste(hi, "-", lo), estimate = mean(d),
    conf.low = unname(quantile(d, 0.025)), conf.high = unname(quantile(d, 0.975)),
    pd = pd, p.value = .pd_to_pvalue(pd, length(d)), ndraws_used = length(d)
  )
}))
mdA13_envvar_contrasts_all$p.value.adj <- p.adjust(mdA13_envvar_contrasts_all$p.value, method = "holm")

# ---- events curve --------------------------------------

mdA13_evts_curve <- avg_predictions_manual(
  mdA13, newdata=grid_evts, by="UASEvents",
  re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
  ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, transform=transform_dAnnoy
)

# ---- events contrasts (2v1, 3v1, 3v2), LAE held at mean ----

mdA13_evts_contrasts <- avg_comparisons_manual(
  mdA13, newdata=grid_evts, variable = "UASEvents", levels = c(1, 2, 3),
  comparison_type = "pairwise", auto_orient = TRUE,
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform = transform_dAnnoy
)

# events contrasts by environment
mdA13_evts_curve_by_env <- avg_predictions_manual(
  mdA13, newdata=grid_evts, by=c("UASEvents", "AmbientEnvCore"),
  re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
  ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, transform=transform_dAnnoy
)

mdA13_evts_contrasts_by_env <- do.call(rbind, lapply(env_order, function(env) {
  res <- avg_comparisons_manual(
    mdA13, newdata=subset(grid_evts, AmbientEnvCore == env),
    variable="UASEvents", levels=c(1, 2, 3),
    comparison_type="pairwise", auto_orient=TRUE,
    re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
    ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, rope=c(-0.2, 0.2), transform=transform_dAnnoy
  )
  cbind(AmbientEnvCore = env, res)
}))
mdA13_evts_contrasts_by_env$p.value.adj <- p.adjust(mdA13_evts_contrasts_by_env$p.value, method='holm')

# events contrasts by type
mdA13_evts_curve_by_type <- avg_predictions_manual(
  mdA13, newdata=grid_evts, by=c("UASEvents", "UASType"),
  re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
  ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, transform=transform_dAnnoy

  res <- avg_comparisons_manual(
    mdA13, newdata=subset(grid_evts, UASType == type),
    variable="UASEvents", levels=c(1, 2, 3),
    comparison_type="pairwise", auto_orient=TRUE,
    re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
    ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, rope=c(-0.2, 0.2), transform=transform_dAnnoy
  )
  cbind(UASType = type, res)
}))
```

### analyse between-subjects contrasts

```{r}

# contrast analysis for between-subjects variables

contrast_vars <- c("Sex", "NationGeo2", "AAM_attitude2", "Home_Area2",
                   "Area_soundscape2")

mdA13_between_contrasts <- purrr::map_dfr(contrast_vars, function(v) {
  res <- avg_comparisons_manual(
    mdA13, newdata = grid_marg, variable = v, comparison_type = "pairwise",
    re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
    ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed=999,
    transform = transform_dAnnoy
  )
  res$variable <- v
  gc()
  return(res)
}) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(contrast_vars)),
    # Create the text label string
    y_label = paste(variable, contrast, sep = ": "),
    
    # Reorder the y-axis labels using the underlying numeric levels of 'variable'
    y_label = fct_reorder(y_label, as.numeric(variable))
  )

slope_vars <- c("AgeScl", "NoiseSensitivityScl")

mdA13_covariate_slopes <- purrr::map_dfr(slope_vars, function(v) {
  res <- avg_slopes_manual(
    mdA13, newdata = grid_marg, variable = v,
    re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
    ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed=999,
    transform = transform_dAnnoy
  )
  gc()
  return(res)
}) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(slope_vars))
  )
```

## mdA14 add further to scale model

### Model dA14 formula

```{R}

mdA14_pop_level <- mdA13_pop_level

mdA14_grp_level <- mdA13_grp_level

mdA14_dpar_pop_level <- c(mdA13_dpar_pop_level, "UASEvents")

mdA14_dpar_grp_level <- list(ID = "UASType")

mdA14formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                        fixed = mdA14_pop_level,
                        re = mdA14_grp_level,
                        dpars = list(phi = list(fixed = mdA14_dpar_pop_level,
                                                re = mdA14_dpar_grp_level)))

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA14 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA14formula, mdA1Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA14_pop_level, tier_priors_dA1, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  # brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "b", dpar = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)


tic()
mdA14Priors <- brms::brm(mdA14formula,
                 data=mdA1Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA14, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA14PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA14Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA14PriorCheck

tic()
mdA14 <- brms::brm(mdA14formula, data=mdA1Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA14, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA14 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA14, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA14$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA14))
mdA14$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA14, re_formula=NA))
mdA14$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA14, re_formula=NULL))

```

# dAnnoyance with LAE instead of UASType, UASoperation and UAProximity

## mdA15: maximal ordbeta model with random intercept only

### Model dA15 formula

```{R}

role_lookup <- c(
  UASStart = "wsf",
  AmbientEnvCore = "wsf", AmbientVariant = "wsf",
  Ilog10UASEvents = "wsc", TrialNumberScl = "wsc", UASLAEMaxLRScl = "wsc",
  NationGeo2 = "bsf", AAM_attitude2 = "bsf", Home_Area2 = "bsf",
  Sex = "bsf", Area_soundscape2 = "bsf",
  AgeScl = "bsc", NoiseSensitivityScl = "bsc"
)

mdA15_pop_level <- c("TrialNumberScl",
                    "UASLAEMaxLRScl*UASStart*AmbientEnvCore",
                    "UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents))*AmbientEnvCore",
                    "UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientVariant",
                    "NationGeo2", "AAM_attitude2", "Home_Area2",
                    "AgeScl", "Sex", "NoiseSensitivityScl", "Area_soundscape2")

mdA15_grp_level_id <- c()

mdA15_grp_level <- list(ID = mdA15_grp_level_id,
                     StimID = c())

mdA15formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                      fixed = mdA15_pop_level,
                      re = mdA15_grp_level)

mdA15Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, all.vars(mdA15formula$formula), drop=FALSE]

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

y_full <- mdA15Data$dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl
n0 <- sum(y_full == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n1 <- sum(y_full == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
N  <- sum(!is.na(y_full))

# Haldane-Anscombe Correction to avoid p0 or p1 being exactly 0 or 1, which would lead to infinite logit values
p0 <- (n0 + 0.5) / (N + 1)
p1 <- (n1 + 0.5) / (N + 1)

xi_center   <- qlogis(p0)              # solves plogis(xi) = p0 exactly
coi_center  <- qlogis(1 - p1)          # solves 1 - plogis(xi+kappa) = p1
kappa_center <- coi_center - xi_center  # must come out positive, given kappa's <lower=0> constraint

y_cont <- na.omit(mdA15Data)$dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl
y_cont <- y_cont[y_cont > 0 & y_cont < 1]
m <- mean(y_cont); v <- stats::var(y_cont)
phi_center <- log((m * (1 - m)) / v - 1)

tier_priors_dA15 <- c("2" = "normal(0, 0.3)", "3" = "normal(0, 0.1)")

main_effects <- list(
  list(vars = "UASLAEMaxLRScl",  prior = "normal(0.2, 0.5)"),
  list(vars = "Ilog10UASEvents", prior = "normal(0.5, 1)"),
  list(vars = "TrialNumberScl",  prior = "normal(0.1, 0.5)")
)

priorsdA15 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA15formula, mdA15Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA15_pop_level, tier_priors_dA15, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)

tic()
mdA15Priors <- brms::brm(mdA15formula,
                 data=mdA15Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA15, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA15PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA15Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA15PriorCheck

tic()
mdA15 <- brms::brm(mdA15formula, data=mdA15Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA15, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA15 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA15, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA15$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA15))
mdA15$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA15, re_formula=NA))
mdA15$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA15, re_formula=NULL))


```

```{r}

summary(mdA15)

```

```{r}
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mdA15, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='AmbientEnvCore') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mdA15, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='AmbientVariant') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mdA15, type = "intervals", x = "UASLAEMaxLRScl",ndraws=100) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), text = element_text(family = 'serif')) +
    rescaleTicks(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR, stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl) +
    labs(x = expression(UAS~italic(L)[AE]~", dB"), y = "Change in annoyance")

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mdA15, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASStart') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
```

## mdA18: further reduced ordbeta model with random intercept only

### Model dA18 formula

```{R}

mdA18_pop_level <- prune_terms(mdA17_pop_level, c("UASStart:AmbientEnvCore"),
                               sanitize_fn = sanitize_var_brms)

mdA18_grp_level <- mdA17_grp_level

mdA18formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                      fixed = mdA18_pop_level,
                      re = mdA18_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA18 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA18formula, mdA15Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA18_pop_level, tier_priors_dA15, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)

tic()
mdA18Priors <- brms::brm(mdA18formula,
                 data=mdA15Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA18, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA18PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA18Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA18PriorCheck

tic()
mdA18 <- brms::brm(mdA18formula, data=mdA15Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA18, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA18 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA18, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA18$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA18))
mdA18$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA18, re_formula=NA))
mdA18$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA18, re_formula=NULL))


```

### summarise

```{r}

summary(mdA18)

```

```{r}

  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mdA18, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='AmbientEnvCore') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mdA18, type = "intervals", x = "UASLAEMaxLRScl",ndraws=100) +

    rescaleTicks(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR, stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl) +

  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mdA18, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASStart') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
```

## mdA21: further reduced ordbeta model with random intercept only

### Model dA21 formula

```{R}

mdA21_pop_level <- prune_terms(mdA20_pop_level, c("I(log10(UASEvents)):AmbientEnvCore"),
                               sanitize_fn = sanitize_var_brms)

mdA21_grp_level <- mdA20_grp_level

mdA21formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                      fixed = mdA21_pop_level,
                      re = mdA21_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA21 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA21formula, mdA15Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA21_pop_level, tier_priors_dA15, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)

tic()
mdA21Priors <- brms::brm(mdA21formula,
                 data=mdA15Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA21, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA21PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA21Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA21PriorCheck

tic()
mdA21 <- brms::brm(mdA21formula, data=mdA15Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA21, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA21 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA21, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA21$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA21))
mdA21$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA21, re_formula=NA))
mdA21$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA21, re_formula=NULL))


```

```{r}
summary(mdA21)
```

```{r}
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")

brms::pp_check(mdA21, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='AmbientEnvCore') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +

brms::pp_check(mdA21, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='AmbientVariant') +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +

brms::pp_check(mdA21, type = "intervals", x = "UASLAEMaxLRScl",ndraws=100) +

    rescaleTicks(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR, stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl) +

brms::pp_check(mdA21, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASStart') +
```

### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

mdA22_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(mdA22) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / stats::median(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(mdA22_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mdA22_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))

```

### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

mdA23_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(mdA23) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / stats::median(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(mdA23_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mdA23_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))

```

## mdA24: further reduce group level effects

### Model dA24 formula

```{R}

mdA24_pop_level <- mdA23_pop_level

mdA24_grp_level_id <- prune_terms(mdA23_grp_level_id,
                                  c("UASLAEMaxLRScl:AmbientVariant"),
                                   sanitize_fn = sanitize_var_brms)

mdA24_grp_level <- list(ID = mdA24_grp_level_id,
                     StimID = c())

mdA24formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                      fixed = mdA24_pop_level,
                      re = mdA24_grp_level)

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA24 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA24formula, mdA15Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA24_pop_level, tier_priors_dA15, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)

tic()
mdA24Priors <- brms::brm(mdA24formula,
                 data=mdA15Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA24, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA24PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA24Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA24PriorCheck

tic()
mdA24 <- brms::brm(mdA24formula, data=mdA15Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA24, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA24 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA24, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA24$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA24))
mdA24$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA24, re_formula=NA))
mdA24$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA24, re_formula=NULL))


```

```{r}
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mdA25_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))

```

## mdA26 add further to scale model

### Model dA26 formula

```{R}

mdA26_pop_level <- mdA25_pop_level

mdA26_grp_level <- mdA25_grp_level

mdA26_dpar_pop_level <- c("UASLAEMaxLRScl")

mdA26_dpar_grp_level <- mdA25_dpar_grp_level

mdA26formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                        fixed = mdA26_pop_level,
                        re = mdA26_grp_level,
                        dpars = list(phi = list(fixed=mdA26_dpar_pop_level,
                                                re = mdA26_dpar_grp_level)))

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA26 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA26formula, mdA15Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA26_pop_level, tier_priors_dA1, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  # brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "b", dpar = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)


tic()
mdA26Priors <- brms::brm(mdA26formula,
                 data=mdA15Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA26, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA26PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA26Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA26PriorCheck

tic()
mdA26 <- brms::brm(mdA26formula, data=mdA15Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA26, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA26 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA26, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA26$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA26))
mdA26$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA26, re_formula=NA))
mdA26$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA26, re_formula=NULL))

```

```{r}
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))

```

## mdA28 modify scale model

### Model dA28 formula

```{R}

mdA28_pop_level <- mdA27_pop_level

mdA28_grp_level <- mdA27_grp_level

mdA28_dpar_pop_level <- c(prune_terms(mdA27_dpar_pop_level,
                                      "AmbientEnvCore",
                                      sanitize_fn=sanitize_var_brms),
                          "UASEvents")

mdA28_dpar_grp_level <- mdA27_dpar_grp_level

mdA28formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                        fixed = mdA28_pop_level,
                        re = mdA28_grp_level,
                        dpars = list(phi = list(fixed=mdA28_dpar_pop_level,
                                                re = mdA28_dpar_grp_level)))

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA28 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA28formula, mdA15Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA28_pop_level, tier_priors_dA1, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  # brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "b", dpar = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)


tic()
mdA28Priors <- brms::brm(mdA28formula,
                 data=mdA15Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA28, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA28PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA28Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA28PriorCheck

tic()
mdA28 <- brms::brm(mdA28formula, data=mdA15Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA28, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA28 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA28, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA28$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA28))
mdA28$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA28, re_formula=NA))
mdA28$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA28, re_formula=NULL))

```

```{r}

mdA28_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(mdA28) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / stats::median(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(mdA28_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mdA28_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))

```

```{R}
mdA30formula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                        fixed = mdA30_pop_level,
                        re = mdA30_grp_level,
                        dpars = list(phi = list(fixed=mdA30_dpar_pop_level,
                                                re = mdA30_dpar_grp_level)))

```

### run model

```{r}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priorsdA30 <- c(
  # mean model
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b", dpar = "mu"),
  derive_coef_priors(mdA30formula, mdA15Data, ordbeta(link = "logit"),
                     mdA30_pop_level, tier_priors_dA1, main_effects),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "sd", lb = 0, dpar = "mu"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "mu"),
  # scale model
  # brms::set_prior(sprintf("lognormal(%.2f, 1)", phi_center), class = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "Intercept", dpar = "phi"),
  brms::set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "b", dpar = "phi"),
  # cutpoints model
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1)", kappa_center), class = "kappa"),
  brms::set_prior(sprintf("normal(%.2f, 1.5)", xi_center), class = "xi")
)


tic()
mdA30Priors <- brms::brm(mdA30formula,
                 data=mdA15Data,
                 family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                 future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
                 prior=priorsdA30, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
                 sample_prior='only', seed=808,
                 chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

mdA30PriorCheck <- brms::pp_check(mdA30Priors, ndraws = 100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
mdA30PriorCheck

tic()
mdA30 <- brms::brm(mdA30formula, data=mdA15Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priorsdA30, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
mdA30 <- brms::add_criterion(mdA30, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

mdA30$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(mdA30))
mdA30$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA30, re_formula=NA))
mdA30$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(mdA30, re_formula=NULL))

```

### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

mdA30_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(mdA30) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / stats::median(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(mdA30_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(mdA30_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Median-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))

```
