### run model 1b

```{R}

m1b_phi_pop_level <- c(1, "AmbientEnvCore", "UASOperation", "UASType",
                       "I(log10(UASEvents))", "TrialNumberScl")

m1b_phi_grp_level <- list(ID=c())

m1bformula <- build_bf(y = "dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                      fixed = m1_pop_level,
                      re = m1_grp_level,
                      sigma_fixed = m1b_phi_pop_level,
                      sigma_re = m1b_phi_grp_level)

priors1b <- c(
  # mean model
  set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class='b', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.2, 1), class='b', coef='UASLAEMaxLRScl', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(1.5, 1), class='b', coef='Ilog10UASEvents', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.1, 1), class='b', coef='TrialNumberScl', dpar='mu'),
  # precision model
  brms::prior(normal(0, 1), class = 'Intercept', dpar = 'phi'),
  brms::prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = 'b', dpar = 'phi')
)

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

tic()
m1b <- brms::brm(m1bformula,
                data=m1Data, family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priors1b, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
m1b <- brms::add_criterion(m1b, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

m1b$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(m1b))
m1b$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m1b, re_formula=NA))
m1b$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m1b, re_formula=NULL))

```

#### plot calibration

```{r}

# create base datagrid
m1bDataFit <- insight::get_data(m1b)

set.seed(999)
m1bpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m1b, na.omit(m1bDataFit),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                re_formula = NULL,
                                                transform=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

gc()

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m1bpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m1bpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m1bpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

```{R}
# create base datagrid
m1bDataFit <- insight::get_data(m1b)
m1bDataFit <- m1bDataFit |> dplyr::mutate(ID=as.character(ID),
                                          StimID=as.character(StimID))

# get unique combinations of the predictors
base_unique <- m1bDataFit |>
    dplyr::distinct(ID, UASProximity, UASType, UASEvents, AmbientEnvCore, AmbientVariant, UASOperation,
                    NationGeo2, AAM_attitude2, Home_Area2,
                    Age, Sex, NoiseSensitivity, Area_soundscape2,
                    .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::group_by(ID, UASProximity, UASType, UASEvents, AmbientEnvCore, AmbientVariant, UASOperation) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
# include mean trial number

# expand grid over LAE

  newdata = base_unique,
  UASLAEMaxLRScl = lae_step,
  grid_type = "counterfactual"
)

grid_marg$StimID <- paste0("new_stim_", new_idx)
```

#### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

m1b_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(m1b) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / mean(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(m1b_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(m1b_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Mean-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))
```

### run model 1c with no UASStart

```{r}

m1c_pop_level <- setdiff(m1_pop_level, "UASStart")

m1c_grp_level <- lapply(m1_grp_level, setdiff, "UASStart")

m1cformula <- build_bf(y="dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl",
                       fixed=m1c_pop_level,
                       re=m1c_grp_level,
                       sigma_fixed=m1b_phi_pop_level,
                       sigma_re=m1b_phi_grp_level)

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

tic()
m1c <- brms::brm(m1cformula,
                 data=m1Data,
                family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priors1b, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads = threading(threads = 3, static = TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
m1c <- brms::add_criterion(m1c, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                          cores=n_cores,
                          reloo=reloo_flag,
                          overwrite=TRUE,
                          chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                          backend='cmdstanr',
                          future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

m1c$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(m1c))
m1c$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m1c, re_formula=NA))
m1c$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m1c, re_formula=NULL))

```

## m0: minimal ordbeta model

### Formula

```{R}

m0formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ 1 + TrialNumberScl +
                    UASProximity +
                    UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
                   AmbientEnvCore + UASOperation +
                   AmbientVariant + UASType +
                   NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                   Age + Sex + NoiseSensitivity + Area_soundscape2 +
                   (1 + UASProximity + UASLAEMaxLRScl + AmbientEnvCore +
                      I(log10(UASEvents)) + AmbientVariant +
                      UASOperation + UASType | ID) +
                     (1 | StimID)

m0Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, all.vars(m0formula), drop=FALSE]

```

### run model 0

```{R}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priors0 <- c(
  # mean model
  set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class='b', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.2, 1), class='b', coef='UASLAEMaxLRScl', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(1.5, 1), class='b', coef='Ilog10UASEvents', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.1, 1), class='b', coef='TrialNumberScl', dpar='mu'),

  # precision model
  brms::prior(normal(0, 1), class = 'Intercept', dpar = 'phi'),
  brms::prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = 'b', dpar = 'phi')
)

tic()
m0 <- brms::brm(brms::bf(m0formula, phi ~ 1 + AmbientEnvCore + UASOperation +
                            UASType + I(log10(UASEvents)) + (1 | ID)),
                data=m0Data, family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priors0, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
m0 <- brms::add_criterion(m0, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

m0$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(m0))
m0$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m0, re_formula=NA))
m0$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m0, re_formula=NULL))

```

## m0b: medial ordbeta model

### Formula

```{R}

m0bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~
  # within-subjects fixed
  1 + TrialNumberScl + UASProximity +
  AmbientEnvCore*UASType + AmbientEnvCore*UASOperation + AmbientVariant +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  # between subjects fixed
  NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
  Age + Sex + NoiseSensitivity + Area_soundscape2 +
  # random effects
  (1 + UASProximity + UASLAEMaxLRScl + AmbientEnvCore + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
     AmbientVariant + UASOperation + UASType | ID) + (1 | StimID)

```

### run model 0b

```{R}
                            UASType + I(log10(UASEvents)) + (1 | ID)),

               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priors0, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()
```

#### plot calibration

```{r}

# create base datagrid
m0dDataFit <- insight::get_data(m0d)

set.seed(999)
m0dpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m0d, na.omit(m0dDataFit),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                re_formula = NULL,
                                                transform=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

gc()

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m0dpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m0dpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m0dpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)


```

## m0e: medial ordbeta model with no UASProximity population-level

### Formula

```{R}

m0eformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~
  # within-subjects fixed
  1 + TrialNumberScl +
  AmbientEnvCore*UASType + AmbientEnvCore*UASOperation + AmbientVariant +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  # between subjects fixed
  NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
  Age + Sex + NoiseSensitivity + Area_soundscape2 +
  # random effects
  (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl + AmbientEnvCore + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
     AmbientVariant + UASOperation + UASType | ID) +
  (1 | StimID)

```

### run model 0e

```{R}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

tic()
m0e <- brms::brm(brms::bf(m0eformula, phi ~ 1 + AmbientEnvCore + UASOperation +
                            UASType + I(log10(UASEvents)) + (1 | ID)),
                data=m0Data, family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priors0, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
m0e <- brms::add_criterion(m0e, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

m0e$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(m0e))
m0e$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m0e, re_formula=NA))
m0e$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m0e, re_formula=NULL))

```

#### plot calibration

```{r}

# create base datagrid
m0eDataFit <- insight::get_data(m0e)

set.seed(999)
m0epredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m0e, na.omit(m0eDataFit),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                re_formula = NULL,
                                                transform=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

gc()

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m0epredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m0epredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m0epredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)


```

## m0g: medial ordbeta model with no UASProximity population-level and with factor UASEvents interaction with ambient env

### Formula

```{R}
# add a factor version of UASEvents to m0Data
m0gData <- m0Data |> dplyr::mutate(UASEvents = factor(UASEvents, levels=c(1, 2, 3)))

m0gformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~
  # within-subjects fixed
  1 + TrialNumberScl +
  AmbientEnvCore*UASEvents +
  AmbientEnvCore*UASType + AmbientEnvCore*UASOperation + AmbientVariant +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*UASEvents +
  # between subjects fixed
  NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
  Age + Sex + NoiseSensitivity + Area_soundscape2 +
  # random effects
  (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl + AmbientEnvCore + UASEvents +
     AmbientVariant + UASOperation + UASType | ID) +
  (1 | StimID)

```

### run model 0g

```{R}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

priors0g <- c(
  # mean model
  set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class='b', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.2, 1), class='b', coef='UASLAEMaxLRScl', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(1, 1), class='b', coef='UASEvents2', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(1, 1), class='b', coef='UASEvents3', dpar='mu'),
  brms::prior(normal(0.1, 1), class='b', coef='TrialNumberScl', dpar='mu'),

  # precision model
  brms::prior(normal(0, 1), class = 'Intercept', dpar = 'phi'),
  brms::prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = 'b', dpar = 'phi')
)

tic()
m0g <- brms::brm(brms::bf(m0gformula, phi ~ 1 + AmbientEnvCore + UASOperation +
                            UASType + UASEvents + (1 | ID)),
                data=m0gData, family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priors0g, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
m0g <- brms::add_criterion(m0g, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

m0g$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(m0g))
m0g$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m0g, re_formula=NA))
m0g$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m0g, re_formula=NULL))

```

#### plot calibration

```{r}

# create base datagrid
m0gDataFit <- insight::get_data(m0g)

set.seed(999)
m0gpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m0g, na.omit(m0gDataFit),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                re_formula = NULL,
                                                transform=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

gc()

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m0gpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m0gpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m0gpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)


```

#### analyse within-subjects effects using marginaleffects

```{R}

# ---- Setup ------------------------------------------------------------------

within_vars_all  <- c("AmbientEnvCore", "UASType", "UASOperation",
                       "AmbientVariant", "UASLAEMaxLRScl", "UASEvents")
between_vars_all <- c("NationGeo2", "AAM_attitude2", "Home_Area2", "Age", "Sex",
                       "NoiseSensitivity", "Area_soundscape2")
 
transform_dAnnoy <- \(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')
 
env_order <- c("Park", "Residential", "Streetside square", "Highway")


# ---- Canonical grids (built once) -------------------------------------------
 
# grid_marg: LAE varies naturally with each real design cell
grid_marg <- build_marginal_grid(
  m0g, within_vars = within_vars_all, between_vars = between_vars_all,
  id_var = "ID", stim_var = "StimID", simulate_id = TRUE, simulate_stim = TRUE,
  n_new = nnew_pred, fixed_at_mean = "TrialNumberScl"
)
 
# grid_fixed_lae: LAE held at its mean
grid_fixed_lae <- build_marginal_grid(
  m0g,
  within_vars = setdiff(within_vars_all, "UASLAEMaxLRScl"),
  between_vars = between_vars_all,
  id_var = "ID", stim_var = "StimID", simulate_id = TRUE, simulate_stim = TRUE,
  n_new = nnew_pred, fixed_at_mean = c("TrialNumberScl", "UASLAEMaxLRScl")
)
 
# ---- Restricted subsets, one per coverage rule above ------------------------
 
# Group 1 only: the single fully-crossed subset. Used for ANY analysis of
# AmbientEnvCore, UASOperation, or UASProximity.
grid_group1 <- subset(grid_marg, UASEvents == 1 & AmbientVariant == "Standard")
grid_group1_fixed_lae <- subset(grid_fixed_lae, UASEvents == 1 &
                                  AmbientVariant == "Standard")

# Far + Overflight + Standard variant, spanning UASEvents 1/2/3: the only
# subset where event count varies while everything else stays within
# combinations that were actually tested.
grid_evts <- subset(grid_marg,
                      UASOperation == "Overflight" &
                        AmbientVariant == "Standard")

grid_evts_fixed_lae <- subset(grid_fixed_lae, UASOperation == "Overflight" &
                                  AmbientVariant == "Standard")


m0g_evts_curve_by_env <- avg_predictions_manual(
  m0g, newdata=grid_evts_fixed_lae, by=c("UASEvents", "AmbientEnvCore"),
  re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
  ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, transform=transform_dAnnoy
)

m0g_evts_contrasts_by_env <- do.call(rbind, lapply(env_order, function(env) {
  res <- avg_comparisons_manual(
    m0g, newdata=subset(grid_evts_fixed_lae, AmbientEnvCore == env),
    variable="UASEvents", levels=c(1, 2, 3),
    comparison_type="pairwise", auto_orient=TRUE,
    re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
    ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, rope=c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform=transform_dAnnoy
  )
  cbind(AmbientEnvCore = env, res)
}))
m0g_evts_contrasts_by_env$p.value.adj <- p.adjust(m0g_evts_contrasts_by_env$p.value, method='holm')

```

```{r}

p_evts_curve_by_env <- ggplot(m0g_evts_curve_by_env, aes(x = UASEvents, y = estimate)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 12)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), linewidth = 1, size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(x = UASEvents, y = estimate)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = mycolours) +
  guides(colour = "none") +
  facet_wrap(vars(AmbientEnvCore)) +
  labs(x = "Number of UAS events", y = expression(bar(Delta*A)))

p_evts_curve_by_env_brackets <- add_pairwise_brackets(
  base_plot = p_evts_curve_by_env, means_df = m0g_evts_curve_by_env,
  contrast_df = m0g_evts_contrasts_by_env, x_var = "UASEvents",
  step_increase = 0.05, y_margin = 0.01) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 8))
p_evts_curve_by_env_brackets

```


## m0h: medial ordbeta model with UASProximity population-level and with UASEvents interaction with ambient env

### Formula

```{R}

m0hformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~
  # within-subjects fixed
  1 + TrialNumberScl +
  UASProximity +
  AmbientEnvCore*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  AmbientEnvCore*UASType + AmbientEnvCore*UASOperation + AmbientVariant +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl +
  # between subjects fixed
  NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
  Age + Sex + NoiseSensitivity + Area_soundscape2 +
  # random effects
  (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl + AmbientEnvCore + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
     AmbientVariant + UASType | ID) +
  (1 | StimID)

```

### run model 0h

```{R}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

tic()
m0h <- brms::brm(brms::bf(m0hformula, phi ~ 1 + AmbientEnvCore + UASOperation +
                            UASType + I(log10(UASEvents)) + (1 | ID)),
                data=m0Data, family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priors0, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
m0h <- brms::add_criterion(m0h, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

m0h$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(m0h))
m0h$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m0h, re_formula=NA))
m0h$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m0h, re_formula=NULL))

```

#### visualise posterior distributions of group level effects

```{r}

m0h_sd_draws <- as.data.frame(m0h) |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("sd_")) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Parameter = gsub("sd_", "", Parameter)) |>  # Clean up label names
    dplyr::group_by(Parameter) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RelValue = Value / mean(Value)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# 2. Plot using ridges with a shared x-axis and normalized curve heights
p_sd <- ggplot(m0h_sd_draws, aes(x = Value, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
     theme(legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16)) +
    # stat_density_ridges normalizes the peak height of each curve individually
    ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)), 
                        geom = "density_ridges", 
                        alpha = 1, 
                        scale = 1.1) + # Controls how much curves can overlap vertically
    # Adds the 50%, 89% and 95% credible intervals right beneath each curve
    tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1), 
                       .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
    labs(x = "Estimated variation (sd scale)",
         y = "Group parameter")

p_sd_rel <- ggplot(m0h_sd_draws, aes(x = RelValue, y = Parameter, fill = Parameter)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggridges::stat_density_ridges(aes(height = after_stat(density)),
                                 geom = "density_ridges",
                                alpha = 1, scale = 0.9) +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(aes(y = as.numeric(as.factor(Parameter)) - 0.1),
                                 .width = c(0.5, 0.89, 0.95),
                                size=1, linewidth=0.5) +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mycolours) +
  labs(x = "Mean-normalised\n(relative estimation uncertainty)",
       y = "Group parameter")

p_sd | (p_sd_rel + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()))

filename <- "dAnnoyMnExpModSD_brmsOb"

if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=12, height=6,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=12, height=6, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

#### analyse within-subjects effects

```{R}

# ---- Setup ------------------------------------------------------------------

within_vars_all  <- c("UASProximity", "AmbientEnvCore", "UASType", "UASOperation",
                       "AmbientVariant", "UASLAEMaxLRScl", "UASEvents")
between_vars_all <- c("NationGeo2", "AAM_attitude2", "Home_Area2", "Age", "Sex",
                       "NoiseSensitivity", "Area_soundscape2")
 
transform_dAnnoy <- \(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')
 
env_order <- c("Park", "Residential", "Streetside square", "Highway")

# ---- full grids -------------------------------------------
 
# grid_marg: LAE varies naturally with each real design cell
grid_marg <- build_marginal_grid(
  m0h, within_vars = within_vars_all, between_vars = between_vars_all,
  id_var = "ID", stim_var = "StimID", simulate_id = TRUE, simulate_stim = TRUE,
  n_new = nnew_pred, fixed_at_mean = "TrialNumberScl"
)
 
# grid_fixed_lae: LAE held at its mean
grid_fixed_lae <- build_marginal_grid(
  m0h,
  within_vars = setdiff(within_vars_all, "UASLAEMaxLRScl"),
  between_vars = between_vars_all,
  id_var = "ID", stim_var = "StimID", simulate_id = TRUE, simulate_stim = TRUE,
  n_new = nnew_pred, fixed_at_mean = c("TrialNumberScl", "UASLAEMaxLRScl")
)

m0hDataFit <- insight::get_data(m0h)
trial_step <- seq(min(m0hDataFit$TrialNumberScl), max(m0hDataFit$TrialNumberScl),
                  length.out=max(subjDataNoAmb$TrialNumber,
                                 na.rm=T))

grid_trial_smooth <- build_marginal_grid(
  m0h, within_vars = within_vars_all, between_vars = between_vars_all,
  id_var = "ID", stim_var = "StimID", simulate_id = TRUE, simulate_stim = TRUE,
  n_new = nnew_pred, counterfactual_vars = list(TrialNumberScl = trial_step)
)

# ---- Restricted subsets, one per coverage rule above ------------------------
 
# Group 1 only: the single fully-crossed subset. Used for ANY analysis of
# AmbientEnvCore, UASOperation, or UASProximity.
grid_group1 <- subset(grid_marg, UASEvents == 1 & AmbientVariant == "Standard")
grid_group1_fixed_lae <- subset(grid_fixed_lae, UASEvents == 1 &
                                  AmbientVariant == "Standard")

# Far + Overflight + Standard variant, spanning UASEvents 1/2/3: the only
# subset where event count varies while everything else stays within
# combinations that were actually tested.
grid_evts <- subset(grid_marg,
                      UASProximity == "Far" &
                        UASOperation == "Overflight" &
                        AmbientVariant == "Standard")

grid_evts_fixed_lae <- subset(grid_fixed_lae, UASProximity == "Far" &
                                  UASOperation == "Overflight" &
                                  AmbientVariant == "Standard")

# ----environment means and pairwise contrasts -------------------------
 

m0h_env_means <- avg_predictions_manual(
  m0h, newdata=grid_group1, by="AmbientEnvCore",
  re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
  ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, transform=transform_dAnnoy
)

m0h_env_contrasts <- avg_comparisons_manual(
  m0h, newdata=grid_group1, variable = "AmbientEnvCore", comparison_type = "pairwise",
  auto_orient = TRUE,
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm',
  transform = transform_dAnnoy
)

# ---- does environment moderate the Type and Operation effects? -------
 
m0h_type_within_env <- avg_simple_effects_manual(
  m0h, newdata=grid_group1, variable = "UASType", within_variable = "AmbientEnvCore",
  levels = c("T150", "H520"),
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform = transform_dAnnoy
)

m0h_type_by_env <- avg_comparisons_cross_manual(
  m0h, newdata=grid_group1, variable1 = "AmbientEnvCore", variable2 = "UASType",
  levels1 = env_order, comparison_type1 = "pairwise", levels2 = c("T150", "H520"),
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform = transform_dAnnoy
)

m0h_op_within_env <- avg_simple_effects_manual(
  m0h, newdata=grid_group1, variable = "UASOperation", within_variable = "AmbientEnvCore",
  levels = c("Delivery", "Overflight"),
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform = transform_dAnnoy
)

m0h_op_by_env <- avg_comparisons_cross_manual(
  m0h, newdata=grid_group1, variable1 = "AmbientEnvCore", variable2 = "UASOperation",
  levels1 = env_order, comparison_type1 = "pairwise", levels2 = c("Delivery", "Overflight"),
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform = transform_dAnnoy
)

# ---- Delivery vs Overflight (overall, within the fully-crossed subset)
 
m0h_op_contrast <- avg_comparisons_manual(
  m0h, newdata=grid_group1, variable = "UASOperation",
  levels = c("Delivery", "Overflight"), auto_orient=TRUE,
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform = transform_dAnnoy
)

# ---- Type and Proximity "at equivalent exposure levels" -------------
# m0h_type_fixed_lae uses the FULL grid_fixed_lae (whole design, natural
# weighting - Overflight/Far conditions contribute more since they're the
# only ones tested across all three stimulus groups) rather than the
# Group-1-restricted subset - explicit choice: Type is fully crossed in
# every group, so no fabrication risk either way, and the whole-design
# answer is the one wanted here. m0h_prox_fixed_lae MUST stay restricted
# to grid_group1_fixed_lae - UASProximity="Near" does not exist outside
# Group 1, so the unrestricted grid would fabricate "Near + multiple
# events" combinations that were never tested.

m0h_op_fixed_lae <- avg_comparisons_manual(
  m0h, grid_fixed_lae, variable = "UASOperation",
  levels = c("Delivery", "Overflight"), auto_orient=TRUE,
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform = transform_dAnnoy
)

m0h_type_fixed_lae <- avg_comparisons_manual(
  m0h, grid_fixed_lae, variable = "UASType",
  levels = c("T150", "H520"), auto_orient=TRUE,
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform = transform_dAnnoy
)
 
m0h_prox_fixed_lae <- avg_comparisons_manual(
  m0h, grid_group1_fixed_lae, variable = "UASProximity", levels = c("Near", "Far"),
  auto_orient = TRUE,
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform = transform_dAnnoy
)


# ---- events curve --------------------------------------

m0h_evts_curve <- avg_predictions_manual(
  m0h, newdata=grid_evts_fixed_lae, by="UASEvents",
  re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
  ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, transform=transform_dAnnoy
)

# ---- events contrasts (2v1, 3v1, 3v2), LAE held at mean ----

m0h_evts_contrasts <- avg_comparisons_manual(
  m0h, newdata=grid_evts_fixed_lae, variable = "UASEvents", levels = c(1, 2, 3),
  comparison_type = "pairwise", auto_orient = TRUE,
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999, rope = c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform = transform_dAnnoy
)

# events contrasts by environment
m0h_evts_curve_by_env <- avg_predictions_manual(
  m0h, newdata=grid_evts_fixed_lae, by=c("UASEvents", "AmbientEnvCore"),
  re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
  ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, transform=transform_dAnnoy
)

m0h_evts_contrasts_by_env <- do.call(rbind, lapply(env_order, function(env) {
  res <- avg_comparisons_manual(
    m0h, newdata=subset(grid_evts_fixed_lae, AmbientEnvCore == env),
    variable="UASEvents", levels=c(1, 2, 3),
    comparison_type="pairwise", auto_orient=TRUE,
    re_formula=NULL, allow_new_levels=TRUE, sample_new_levels="gaussian",
    ndraws=ndraws_pred, seed=999, rope=c(-0.2, 0.2), p_adjust='holm', transform=transform_dAnnoy
  )
  cbind(AmbientEnvCore = env, res)
}))
m0h_evts_contrasts_by_env$p.value.adj <- p.adjust(m0h_evts_contrasts_by_env$p.value, method='holm')

m0h_trial_curve_smooth <- avg_predictions_manual(
  m0h, newdata = grid_trial_smooth, by = "TrialNumberScl",
  re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  ndraws = ndraws_pred, seed = 999,
  transform = \(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')
)
```

#### analyse between-subjects contrasts

```{r}
# contrast analysis for between-subjects variables

contrast_vars <- c("Sex", "NationGeo2", "AAM_attitude2", "Home_Area2",
                    "Area_soundscape2")

m0h_between_contrasts <- purrr::map_dfr(contrast_vars, function(v) {
  res <- avg_comparisons_manual(
    m0h, newdata = grid_marg, variable = v, comparison_type = "pairwise",
    re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
    ndraws = ndraws_pred,
    transform = \(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')
  )
  res$variable <- v
  gc()
  return(res)
}) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(contrast_vars)),
    # Create the text label string
    y_label = paste(variable, contrast, sep = ": "),
    
    # Reorder the y-axis labels using the underlying numeric levels of 'variable'
    y_label = fct_reorder(y_label, as.numeric(variable))
  )
  
slope_vars <- c("Age", "NoiseSensitivity")

m0h_covariate_slopes <- purrr::map_dfr(slope_vars, function(v) {
  res <- avg_slopes_manual(
    m0h, newdata = grid_marg, variable = v,
    re_formula = NULL, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
    ndraws = ndraws_pred,
    transform = \(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')
  )
  gc()
  return(res)
}) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(slope_vars))
  )
```

## m0i: as m0h but swapping StimID group level for UASOperation group level

### Formula

```{R}

m0iformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~
  # within-subjects fixed
  1 + TrialNumberScl +
  UASProximity +
  AmbientEnvCore*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  AmbientEnvCore*UASType + AmbientEnvCore*UASOperation + AmbientVariant +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl +
  # between subjects fixed
  NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
  Age + Sex + NoiseSensitivity + Area_soundscape2 +
  # random effects
  (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl + AmbientEnvCore + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
     AmbientVariant + UASType + UASOperation | ID)

```

### run model 0i

```{R}

chains <- 4

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = chains)

tic()
m0i <- brms::brm(brms::bf(m0iformula, phi ~ 1 + AmbientEnvCore + UASOperation +
                            UASType + I(log10(UASEvents)) + (1 | ID)),
                data=m0Data, family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
               future=TRUE, backend='cmdstanr', init=0,
               prior = priors0, control=list(adapt_delta=0.95),
               threads=threading(threads=3, static=TRUE),  # check threads*chains = n_cores
               seed=808, chains=chains, iter=2000, warmup=1000)
toc()

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 6)

tic()
m0i <- brms::add_criterion(m0i, criterion=c('loo', 'loo_R2'),
                           cores=n_cores,
                           reloo=reloo_flag,
                           overwrite=TRUE,
                           chains=2, iter=1500, warmup=750,  # check workers*chains = n_cores
                           backend='cmdstanr',
                           future_args=list(future.seed=TRUE))
toc()

m0i$criteria$loo_R2_summary <- as.data.frame(brms::loo_R2(m0i))
m0i$criteria$bayes_R2_marginal <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m0i, re_formula=NA))
m0i$criteria$bayes_R2_conditional <- as.data.frame(brms::bayes_R2(m0i, re_formula=NULL))

```

#### check posterior predictive distribution

```{r}

m0iPostCheck <- brms::pp_check(m0i, ndraws=100) +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
m0iPostCheck

m0iPostCheckEnv <- brms::pp_check(m0i, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='AmbientEnvCore') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
m0iPostCheckEnv

m0iPostCheckEnv <- brms::pp_check(m0i, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='AmbientVariant') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
m0iPostCheckEnv

m0iPostCheckEvt <- brms::pp_check(m0i, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASEvents') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
m0iPostCheckEvt

m0iPostCheckType <- brms::pp_check(m0i, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASType') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
m0iPostCheckType

m0iPostCheckOp <- brms::pp_check(m0i, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASOperation') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
m0iPostCheckOp

m0iPostCheckProx <- brms::pp_check(m0i, type='dens_overlay_grouped', ndraws=100, group='UASProximity') +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(), text=element_text(family='serif')) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.25),labels=seq(-10, 10, by=5), limits=c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
m0iPostCheckProx

```

#### diagnostics

```{R, fig.width=25, fig.height=25}

# collinearity check
performance::check_collinearity(m0i)

bayesplot::mcmc_pairs(brms::as_draws_matrix(m0i), pars = c("b_UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                           "b_Ilog10UASEvents",
                                                           "b_UASProximityNear",
                                                           "b_UASOperationDelivery",
                                                           "b_UASTypeT150",
                                                           "b_AmbientEnvCoreResidential",
                                                           "b_AmbientEnvCoreStreetsidesquare",
                                                           "b_AmbientEnvCoreHighway"),
                               off_diag_args=list(alpha=0.5, size=0.7))


```

#### compare performance

```{R}

loo::pareto_k_table(loo::loo(m0i))

# make a table of the bayes_R2 values and quantiles for each model
get_Br2_table(m0, m0b, m0c, m0d, m0e, m0f, m0g, m0h, m0i)

m0i_loo <- loo::loo_compare(m0, m0b, m0c, m0d, m0e, m0f, m0g, m0h, m0i, criterion='loo')
m0i_loo

```

```{r}
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance")
```

#### plot calibration

```{r}

# create base datagrid
m0kDataFit <- insight::get_data(m0k)

set.seed(999)
m0kpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m0k, na.omit(m0kDataFit),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                re_formula = NULL,
                                                transform=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

gc()

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m0kpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m0kpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m0kpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)


```
